unknowns.item: Geocoder puts the Institut on the wrong plot
unknowns.why: Typing 'Camí Antic de València 35' or '37' lands on plot 3241427DF3834A (Escola Pere IV, red). The Institut is on 3241428DF3834A (yellow, Batista 1). Running step 01 from the Institut's address gives the wrong roof.
unknowns.next: Run the yellow roof from its point or its refcat (as data/host/cep9_yellow.json does), not from the address.

unknowns.item: Where the real panel blocks are
unknowns.why: Per-roof counts (43 + 65) are a count from a photo. The 4 traced blocks add up to 187 m², but 108 panels of 540 W need about 278 m², and it is not confirmed which roof each block is on.
unknowns.next: Ask CEP9 or the installer for the panel plan.

unknowns.item: Does Escola Pere IV use the solar power?
unknowns.why: Its roof carries 43 panels, but the CEP9 member list names only the Institut.
unknowns.next: Ask CEP9 whether Pere IV is a member; until then treat it as a roof only.

unknowns.item: Fire station outline is cut off, and it already has PV
unknowns.why: Its plot runs onto LiDAR sheet 432584, which we do not have, so the north-west end of the building (with panels on it) is missing. The roof already carries many panels, so as a guest it may need less from CEP9.
unknowns.next: Download ICGC LiDAR sheet 432584 and rerun step 01; count its panels in step 02.

unknowns.item: Where the 30 homes are and what they use
unknowns.why: No addresses, so no cadastral references, distances or real demand. The 400-700 kWh/yr is their share of the solar, not what they use.
unknowns.next: Ask CEP9 for postcodes or the street of each home; until then use a typical home profile.

unknowns.item: Real hourly demand of every participant
unknowns.why: Every member's demand is an average per building type, not a meter reading.
unknowns.next: Ask the Ajuntament (Datadis / municipal energy office) for 2023-2025 hourly data for the 4 public buildings.

unknowns.item: Real sharing coefficients and the tariff each member pays
unknowns.why: Our shares (school 30%, homes 23%, rest split) are reconstructed, not CEP9's registered RD 244/2019 coefficients.
unknowns.next: Ask CEP9 for the coefficient file.

unknowns.why: Members are 34-244 m from the host. The tool defaults to 100 m (direct wiring). The CEP9 presentation says members are within 2 km; the site file uses RD 244/2019's 500 m. Only Can Felipa is inside 100 m.
unknowns.next: Run step 07 with both the 100 m default and --legal-mode.

unknowns.why: heritage_protected is null for both roofs.
unknowns.next: Download the Open Data BCN heritage catalogue (see known_gaps.json).
